name: byte-range
source: local a,b,c=string.byte("abc",1,3); assert(a==97 and b==98 and c==99)

name: byte-empty
source: local a,b=string.byte(""); assert(a==nil and b==nil)

name: byte-empty-pack
source: assert(select("#",string.byte(""))==0)

name: codepoint-range
source: local a,b,c=utf8.codepoint("A😀é",1,7); assert(a==65 and b==128512 and c==233)

name: codepoint-empty
source: local a,b=utf8.codepoint("",1,0); assert(a==nil and b==nil)

name: match-captures
source: local a,b=string.match("a12","(%a)(%d+)"); assert(a=="a" and b=="12")

name: match-position
source: local a:number,b:string=string.match("abc","()(%a+)"); assert(a==1 and b=="abc")

name: match-not-found
source: local a,b=string.match("abc","z"); assert(a==nil and b==nil)

name: global-unpack
source: local a,b,c=unpack({1,"two",true}); assert(a==1 and b=="two" and c==true)

name: table-unpack
source: local a,b,c=table.unpack({1,"two",true}); assert(a==1 and b=="two" and c==true)

name: unpack-empty
source: assert(select("#",unpack({},1,0))==0 and select("#",table.unpack({},1,0))==0)

name: select-tail
source: local a,b=select(2,1,"two",true); assert(a=="two" and b==true)

name: select-empty
source: assert(select("#",select(3,1,2))==0)

name: select-count
source: local n=select("#",1,nil,3); assert(n==3)

name: pcall-values
source: local ok,a,b=pcall(function() return 1,"two" end); assert(ok and a==1 and b=="two")

name: pcall-empty
source: local ok=pcall(function() end); assert(ok)

name: pcall-error
source: local ok,err=pcall(function() error({marker=true}) end); assert(not ok and type(err)=="table")

name: xpcall-values
source: local ok,a,b=xpcall(function() return 1,"two" end,function(err) return err end); assert(ok and a==1 and b=="two")

name: xpcall-empty
source: local ok=xpcall(function() end,function(err) return err end); assert(ok)

name: resume-values
source: local co=coroutine.create(function() return 1,"two" end); local ok,a,b=coroutine.resume(co); assert(ok and a==1 and b=="two")

name: resume-empty
source: local co=coroutine.create(function() end); local ok=coroutine.resume(co); assert(ok)

name: yield-resume-values
source: local co=coroutine.create(function() local a,b=coroutine.yield(1,"two"); assert(a==3 and b=="four"); return 5,"six" end); local ok,a,b=coroutine.resume(co); assert(ok and a==1 and b=="two"); local ok2,c,d=coroutine.resume(co,3,"four"); assert(ok2 and c==5 and d=="six")

name: byte-alias
source: local read=string.byte; local a,b=read("ab",1,2); assert(a==97 and b==98)

name: match-field
source: local readers={read=string.match}; local a,b=readers.read("a12","(%a)(%d+)"); assert(a=="a" and b=="12")

name: pcall-wrapper
source: local function run() return pcall(function() return 1,"two" end) end; local ok,a,b=run(); assert(ok and a==1 and b=="two")

name: grouped-byte
source: local a,b=(string.byte("ab",1,2)); assert(a==97 and b==nil)

name: nonfinal-pcall
source: local ok,a,b=pcall(function() return 1,"two" end),9; assert(ok and a==9 and b==nil)

name: byte-first-type
source: local a:string=string.byte("a"); assert(type(a)=="number")

name: pcall-status-type
source: local ok:string,a,b=pcall(function() return 1,2 end); assert(type(ok)=="boolean"); print(a,b)

name: native-final-unpack
source: local a=lljson.encode(table.unpack({42})); assert(a=="42")

name: native-excess-before-unpack
source: lljson.encode(42,{},table.unpack({42}))
staticBoundary: The known prefix equals max arity and table.unpack has minimum zero. Literal-table/range count inference is not modeled; runtime rejects the actual nonempty tail.
